query:
SELECT c.essais_code,
                      (c.code_bloque_le IS NOT NULL
                       AND (c.code_debloque_le IS NULL
                            OR c.code_debloque_le < c.code_bloque_le)) AS "bloque!",
                      (SELECT l.id FROM commandes.livraison l
                        WHERE l.commande_id = c.id LIMIT 1) AS "livraison_id?"
               FROM commandes.commande c WHERE c.id = $1
               FOR UPDATE
